tests.name: clamped_channel_is_in_unit_interval
tests.note: For a positive reference, clamp(channel/reference,0,1) lies in [0,1].

tests.name: nonpositive_ratio_clamps_to_zero
tests.note: A nonpositive normalized channel input maps to the lower endpoint.

tests.name: ratio_at_least_one_clamps_to_one
tests.note: A normalized channel input at or above one maps to the upper endpoint.

tests.name: interior_ratio_is_unchanged
tests.note: On [0,1], the clamp is the identity, including both endpoints.

tests.name: identity_wrapper_equals_raw_product
tests.note: In the current measurement case C_W(y)=y, wrapped coherence equals the product.

tests.name: richer_wrapper_axioms_are_consistent_on_finite_sample
tests.note: A nonidentity wrapper can satisfy zero preservation and sampled range closure.

tests.name: positive_fixed_point_is_not_forced_by_wrapper_axioms
tests.note: The constant-zero wrapper satisfies the stated axioms and has no positive fixed point.
